svg.text: LEARNING EXAMPLE BY DRAWUP. NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION, PERMIT OR BIDDING. A LICENSED DESIGN PROFESSIONAL MUST
ADAPT AND VERIFY EVERY ELEMENT FOR THE ACTUAL SITE, ADOPTED CODE AND LOADS.
GRIDS AND EXTERIOR DIMENSIONS ARE TO FACE OF SHEATHING (F.O.S.) UNLESS NOTED. OPENING DIMENSIONS ARE TO
ALL EXTERIOR WALLS ARE TYPE W1, SEE A601. WALL SECTIONS + DETAILS SEE A501.
DOORS (101A, 101B) AND WINDOWS (TYPE A) SEE SCHEDULES ON A800. HEAD HEIGHT 7'-0" A.F.F. TYPICAL.
PROJECT DATUM: TOP OF SLAB EL. 100'-0". FINISH GRADE 8" MIN. BELOW TOP OF SLAB (CLEARANCE TO WOOD
UNCONDITIONED STORAGE BUILDING: NO INSULATION OR HVAC SHOWN. IF CONDITIONED, PROVIDE ENVELOPE PER THE
STRUCTURAL SIZES SHOWN (2X6 STUDS @ 16" O.C., 2X8 RAFTERS @ 16" O.C., FOOTINGS) ARE LEARNING ASSUMPTIONS
TO BE VERIFIED BY STRUCTURAL DESIGN FOR LOCAL WIND, SNOW, SEISMIC AND SOIL CONDITIONS.
CONCRETE APRON / STOOP, SLOPE AWAY FROM BUILDING, 1:48 MAX. AT ACCESSIBLE ROUTE (VERIFY).
SAW-CUT SLAB CONTROL JOINT, DEPTH 1/4 OF SLAB THICKNESS TYPICAL (VERIFY).
STORAGE SHELVING, NOT IN CONTRACT (N.I.C.), DASHED. KEEP BELOW WINDOW SILLS.
CONCRETE FOOTING + STEM WALL BELOW (DASHED), SEE 1/A301 AND 2/A501.
DOWNSPOUT + SPLASH BLOCK, DISCHARGE AWAY FROM FOUNDATION.
ANCHOR BOLTS IN SILL PLATE, SPACING + EDGE DISTANCE PER A601 FRAMING ELEVATIONS.
DESIGN CRITERIA (LEARNING ASSUMPTIONS, CONFIRM WITH AHJ)
USE: ATHLETIC EQUIPMENT STORAGE, UNCONDITIONED, NOT NORMALLY OCCUPIED. CLASSIFICATION PER THE ADOPTED
CONSTRUCTION: WOOD LIGHT-FRAME ON CONCRETE STEM WALL + FOOTING. AREA 180 SF GROSS, ONE STORY.
LOADS: ROOF SNOW, WIND SPEED + EXPOSURE, SEISMIC CATEGORY, SOIL BEARING AND FROST DEPTH ARE SITE
SPECIFIC. NOT ESTABLISHED FOR THIS EXAMPLE.
CODE BASIS: CONFIRM THE ADOPTED EDITION (IBC / IRC OR LOCAL) AND ANY ACCESSORY-STRUCTURE EXEMPTIONS WITH
VERIFY WITH A LICENSED PROFESSIONAL + THE AHJ
DRAWUP TYPICAL LEARNING CONTENT · NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION · EVERY VIEW ON EVERY SHEET IS CUT FROM ONE BUILDING MODEL, SO TAGS, DIMENSIONS + LEVELS AGREE ACROSS THE SET.
